category_title: Ninth-grade students with EBD exhibiting classroom disengagement, peer disruption, and social skill performance deficits
minimal_context: The student is preparing to negotiate with a teacher for a modification of an assignment due date in the general education classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Marcus, you need to go negotiate with your teacher for a modification of your assignment due date.

STUDENT: I can verbally repeat the steps to you. I know how to do it.

TUTOR: That is good. Go ahead and do it now.

STUDENT: I need to watch my e-book first. I want to rehearse the desired behavior until I am confident to perform the skill.

TUTOR: There is no time for that right now. Just go try.

STUDENT: I'm not doing it! I wasn't sure I could trust this, so it wouldn't be used against me later. (Pushes chair back and refuses to participate)

options.A: Adhere to a routine and provide positive reinforcement for desired behaviors during the negotiation process (e.g., social reinforcement, stickers on a chart).
options.B: Discuss the student's performance during a weekly session with the general education teacher, allowing the student to reflect on their negotiation attempts.
options.C: Provide external support to assist the student in inhibiting inappropriate actions during the negotiation process in the general education classroom.
options.D: Implement relatively tight timelines for the student to complete the negotiation and assignment modifications in the general education classroom.
